modules.name: img_geo_pixel_invert
limitations: Unsigned full-range bitwise inversion only; no limited-range YCbCr interpretation
One elastic output slot; native CE-gated stream

modules.name: img_geo_crop_decimate
limitations: Integer point decimation only; no antialias low-pass stage
Runtime remainder operator needs area/timing optimization
One complete configured source frame per command; metadata mismatch is reported after consuming configured frame length

modules.name: img_geo_raster_coords
limitations: 16-bit nonzero width/height
Completion means coordinates accepted, not final downstream memory/output completion

modules.name: img_geo_inverse_map
limitations: Shared iterative58-bit radix2 divider with split29-bit magnitude/subtract/restore; registered matrix products and full-precision sums
Asymmetric resize sampling grid; Q16.8 mapped coordinates
Affine/projective inverse coefficients supplied by host; no matrix inversion/calibration
Only right-angle direct rotations; arbitrary-angle rotation uses supplied affine coefficients
Outside-source coordinates marked as border; zero projective denominator returns error
Scale240CE; affine2CE; perspective241CE; direct modes0CE. Physical qualification is grayscale8/MAX4x3 only

modules.name: img_geo_frame_sampler
limitations: Nearest and bilinear only; other filter modes return unsupported
One outstanding read, no cache or memory timeout
Four memory reads for every bilinear sample, including duplicate edge reads
Shared CE contract; registered external memory response required
PIXEL_W 1..16, ADDR_W 1..32, LANES positive; packed pixel word addresses
Bilinear latency7 enabled edges after final RAM response; exact partial products with single final rounding; CE/backpressure/asynchronous abort tested

modules.name: img_geo_frame_transform
limitations: External completed stable source frame required; use img_geo_frame_buffered for built-in synchronous RAM
Nearest/bilinear filters; use img_geo_area_resample for area integration/SSAA resolve
No external memory timeout or burst adapter; arithmetic resources not measured
Per-pixel faults emit border and completion error; no learned SR model

modules.name: img_geo_frame_writer
limitations: One acknowledged packed pixel write at a time; no bursts
No response timeout or frame rollback
Dimensions and metadata checked against configured raster; framing faults may leave partial output frame
Shared CE contract; external registered memory response required

modules.name: img_geo_super_resolution_stub
limitations: Legacy name retained; now integer bilinear upsampling, not an unsupported placeholder
No learned model, training weights, or restored-detail claim

modules.name: img_geo_frame_buffered
limitations: MAX_WIDTH/MAX_HEIGHT default 64 source pixels per dimension; configurable synchronous frame RAM
Capture and replay are sequential; one complete frame per command
Modes 0..8 and nearest/bilinear only; source marker errors return without output
No timeout for incomplete input; reset aborts transaction

modules.name: img_geo_area_resample
limitations: Exact piecewise-constant pixel-area box integration; not ideal bandlimited filtering
Supports antialiased reduction, fractional area resize, and SSAA resolve
MAX_WIDTH/MAX_HEIGHT default 64; synchronous internal source frame
Sequential overlapped-pixel accumulation; arithmetic area/timing not measured

modules.name: img_geo_integer_upsample
limitations: Integer scale 1..15 with bilinear asymmetric-grid interpolation
DATA_W must equal PIXEL_W*LANES; default RGB888
No learned super-resolution inference or trained weights

production_geometry_frame_integration.physical_scope: Isolated grayscale8 frame geometry, MAX_WIDTH=4, MAX_HEIGHT=3. 14 commands, 168 inputs, 182 outputs and 2 expected error responses. Nearest/bilinear geometry with scale, rotation, mirror, affine and external perspective mapping; CE/backpressure/reset/error recovery. Actual 50MHz/CE13/16, no timing exception; no larger-frame timing or continuous-video throughput signoff.
